name: XXL-JOB Console
description: Manage XXL-JOB tasks, logs and executors with DBX built-in AI and MCP, scoped permissions and confirmed operation previews.
releaseNotes: 0.4.3 restores external MCP tools on newer DBX hosts by declaring all 22 tool access levels and 5 toolsets, and adds fuzzy search to executor dropdowns with keyboard navigation. New jobs inherit the executor selected in job management, keeping installations with 1000+ executors usable. Keeps 2.2.x/2.3.x/3.4.x/3.5.x profiles, scoped permissions and preview-confirmed writes. Requires DBX 0.6.43+ and Host API ^1.4.0.
